item.title: Re: Machine learning based screening of potential paper mill publications in cancer research: methodological and cross sectional study
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, I read the cross-sectional methodological study by Scancar et al. with strong interest. The authors clearly state that model outputs are intended as a statistical screening signal rather than an attribution of misconduct, and that expert review is required before any integrity judgment. item.title: Re: “It brings joy to the working day”—the paediatric doctor boosting morale through baking
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, As a fellow baker, I also find myself very often bringing baked goods to work to share with the team. And yes, it definitely does boost morale. However, beyond this, I have found baking to be an effective tool to help manage my own wellbeing and stress outside of work. item.title: Re: GP contract overhaul: What’s included and how has it been received?
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor: Not mentioned, and not quite so important I suppose, is the total absence of a proper system to ensure that GPs are distributed equitably. That stopped with the abolition of the Medical Practices Committee for England and and Wales in the Health and Social Care Act 2001. item.title: Re: Tessa Richards: BMJ editor who championed patients
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor: I'm happy to endorse Richard Smith's obituary in a very small way, being one of her many non-peer reviewers, and having my comments taken into account. I never met her, but admired all she did to implement patient and public participation in research. item.title: Evidence, transparency, and scope: concerns about Doctronic’s performance claims in Utah’s AI renewal sandbox
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor We commend Utah for attempting to bring regulation closer to innovation through a sandbox-style pathway. item.title: Re: GP contract overhaul: What’s included and how has it been received?
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The government is well intentioned in trying to increase accessibility to General Practice.
